name: Mühlheim am Main (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Mühlheim am Main (a white mill wheel and three roses on blue).
history: The flag was approved for the municipality by the Hessian Minister of the Interior on 2 August 1951, with the arms on the widened white middle stripe of a red-white-red cloth.

features.role: Mühlheim am Main arms — mill wheel and roses on blue
